q: The Wasserstein-2 distance W₂(μ,ν) between two probability measures is defined as:
opts: (inf_γ ∫|x−y|² dγ(x,y))^{1/2} over couplings γ with marginals μ, ν
exp: W₂(μ,ν) = (min over couplings γ of ∫|x−y|² dγ)^{1/2}. This is the L² version of the Kantorovich-Wasserstein distance. The Kantorovich duality gives the dual formulation via (φ, ψ) with φ(x)+ψ(y) ≤ |x−y|².
